name: button
title: Button
description: Raised, flat, outlined and floating buttons with ink ripples, sizes, colors and a pulse effect.
improvements: Pointer Events ripple: no double-firing on touch devices, sized to the farthest corner, no global listeners.
Ripples are skipped when the user prefers reduced motion.
Visible keyboard focus ring and a hover/focus/press state layer that works in any color.
asChild renders links (or any element) with button styling; disabled links use aria-disabled.
